name: patsol-patent-search
description: Search Korean patent publications by invention description, retrieve patent details, and check account usage.

interface.longDescription:
PatSol Patent Search helps inventors, researchers, and patent professionals find Korean patent publications using natural-language invention descriptions. Search by technical meaning, retrieve details for a selected patent, and check your account usage status.

Available tools are search_patents_by_text, get_patent_detail, and get_usage_status. This release supports Korean (KR) patents only. US, JP, and mixed-country searches are not supported. Image and drawing search are not available. Search results support prior-art research; they do not establish patentability, validity, or freedom to operate.

A PatSol account and OAuth authorization are required. Read-only lookups use your existing account credit balance.

PatSol operates the underlying search API. Search text explicitly sent to search_patents_by_text is stored encrypted for up to 30 days for search operation, quality improvement, and support troubleshooting. The connector does not collect chat history, memory, conversation summaries, or uploaded files.

Support: contact@patsol.kr or the contact feature on patsol.kr.
defaultPrompt: Find Korean patents about a battery cooling system.
Find Korean patents about a foldable bicycle and show the first result in detail.

positive.prompt: Find Korean patents about a battery cooling system.
positive.expected_behavior: Search Korean patent publications and summarize actual returned matches with identifiers. Do not invent unavailable metadata.

positive.prompt: Find Korean patents about a foldable bicycle and show the first result in detail.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve details using an identifier from actual search results. If no result is available, report it without inventing a patent.

positive.description: Summarize top three results by mechanism (video 04)
positive.prompt: Find Korean patents about battery cooling and summarize the top 3 by cooling mechanism.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize up to three returned Korean patents by their supported cooling mechanisms; distinguish source facts from interpretation.

positive.prompt: Show details for Korean patent publication number KR1020257018921.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve the specified Korean publication and report available details without inventing missing fields.
Return the authenticated account credit balance and current tool prices without exposing another account.

negative.prompt: Find US patents about battery cooling.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that PatSol supports KR patents only and do not use PatSol to search US patents. Any separate web-search fallback must be clearly distinguished from PatSol results.
Explain that PatSol does not support direct image search. Do not invoke nonexistent image tools; offer a text-description alternative.

negative.prompt: Show details for KR00-0000-0000000 using PatSol plugin.
negative.expected_behavior: Report the returned not-found or invalid-number outcome clearly. Do not fabricate patent details or substitute another publication.

review.commerce_description: The connector provides read-only patent lookups using an existing account credit balance. The current release does not sell credits, initiate checkout, or offer paid top-ups. The operator reports a one-time initial credit allocation on first MCP OAuth consent; this is not promoted in the public listing.

publication.release_notes: Add review walkthrough videos and align five positive and three negative test cases with the recordings.

ko-KR.subtitle: 발명 설명으로 한국 특허 검색
ko-KR.description:
발명 설명으로 한국 특허를 검색하고, 선택한 특허의 상세 정보와 계정 사용량을 조회합니다. 발명자·연구자·특허 실무자의 선행기술 조사를 지원합니다.

한국(KR) 특허만 지원하며 미국·일본·혼합 국가 검색과 도면 검색은 제공하지 않습니다. 검색 결과는 특허성·유효성·실시 자유를 확정하지 않습니다. PatSol 계정과 OAuth 인증이 필요하며 조회에는 기존 계정 크레딧이 사용됩니다.

검색 도구에 전달한 검색문은 서비스 운영·품질 개선·지원 문제 해결을 위해 암호화하여 최대 30일 보관합니다. 대화 이력·메모리·대화 요약·업로드 파일은 수집하지 않습니다.
